goal: Implement editable pre-generation try-on prompts and a persistent material basket, preserving existing image, draft, history and provider workflows.
outcome: Implemented and verified locally; GATE: PASS.

promptEditor: Automatic/manual mode, ordered image-role map, copy and reset.
Manual text remains unchanged when settings/references change. Blank manual text survives draft storage but blocks generation.
Draft, history replay and failed-slot retries retain the captured custom prompt.
Public recipe links/JSON exclude custom text by default; explicit opt-in includes it. Oversized share links suggest JSON download.
Automatic batch preview identifies image 1 and explains variation; manual batches use identical text for every slot.
materialBasket: Catalog IDs only, across tool-page navigation and reloads. No personal images or API keys stored.
Add/remove/clear with duplicate and role/count validation, plus visible replacement/limit feedback.
Use in try-on merges into the existing draft, retaining the person photo, clothing, settings and prompt; reference replacement requires confirmation.
Use in generation sends every selected reference, with roles/order retained in request snapshots, history export and replay.
Successful try-on transfer consumes only its own route state. Failed/declined transfers and newer navigation are preserved.

throughputCheckpoint.blockingFirstSteps: Traced draft/recipe/router/request contracts before fan-out; verified clean starting commit and existing passing checks.
throughputCheckpoint.independentWorkstreams: One integration owner coordinated disjoint basket and generation workers; root independently authored browser tests and reviewed artifacts.
throughputCheckpoint.sharedMutableState: Shared catalog-file conversion extracted once. Hook/recipe/prompt ownership stayed with the integrator; root browser tests and QA docs remained separate.
throughputCheckpoint.smallestSafeDecomposition: Three implementation slices with one integration owner, followed by a read-only reviewer and a narrowly scoped routing bug fix.

verification.reviewFinding: Reproduced removed material returning after reload on the first build; fixed one-shot route-state consumption and passed the same browser regression on the final build.

deliveryAtVerification: Local working tree only; not committed, pushed or deployed.
